title: Cardinal DriveSense Deductible Reduction on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Claims
content:
**Program term.** A vehicle enrolled in Cardinal DriveSense earns a reduction of its Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim deductible from its driving score. Where the vehicle's DriveSense enrollment is scored with a final score of 90 or higher, the deductible after the loyalty reduction is reduced by 20 percent of itself; where it is scored with a final score of at least 75 but below 90, the flat amount of 50 is subtracted from it; where the vehicle has no scored DriveSense enrollment, or its final score is below 75, it is not reduced. The reduced figure never goes below zero, and it is carried unrounded: the accepted-claim deductible is rounded to the cent only at the end.

The enrollment status and final score are read from the vehicle's Cardinal DriveSense enrollment record.

## Reduction by enrollment and score

| Cardinal DriveSense enrollment status | Final score | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Scored | 90 or higher | 20 percent of the deductible after the loyalty reduction |
| Scored | 75 to below 90 | 50 subtracted, never below zero |
| Scored | Below 75 | None |
| Enrolled, observing, opted out or terminated | Any | None |
| No enrollment on the vehicle | — | None |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Deductible after the loyalty reduction of 400:
- Scored, final score 90: reduced by 20 percent of 400, that is 80, leaving 320.
- Scored, final score 89: 50 subtracted, leaving 350.
- Scored, final score 75: 50 subtracted, leaving 350.
- Scored, final score 74: not reduced, 400.
- Observing, any score: not reduced, 400.

Deductible after the loyalty reduction of 30, scored with a final score of 80: subtracting 50 would go below zero, so the figure is 0.
